regions.name: wheel-ring
regions.note: the top of the wheel: the won slice filling it (end animation) and the #2b2b2b rim (the 3D item can reach over it on long models; the bob phase is the capture's)

regions.name: name-card
regions.note: #spinItemName: the won item's name, type and NEW, faded in (itemNameFocus 1) (the 3D item's bob phase and confetti reach into it)

regions.name: item
regions.note: #spinItemCanvas: the 3D item (spin_wheel.c) with the rarity's drop-shadow glow; the bob (sin(t) * 0.55 units) is at the real-time capture's phase, so a loose bound

regions.name: buttons
regions.note: #spinUIBtns: respin price, info and Equip Item (v10's Material Icons 'refresh' glyph is drawn rotated the other way: ~4.6%, the icon font's version)
